description: A Foxhound Client's hello accepted by a Foxhound engine, then its run.start answered with one of Foxhound's own Error codes, here client_gone of the unavailable group, which stands for any code only Foxhound's part of the catalog carries; the Client then closes.

error.message: The Connection the attempt's request went on ended before its handler answered.

data.fix: Start the program again: the attempt is retried on another Connection that serves the crawl.
